text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Seiun Sky didn't show up for morning training.
Apparently, she hasn't even come to school.
choice_data_list: (What can I do right now...?)
(What can I do right now...?)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I used my head to overcome it.
...Yeah, I knew that all along, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If anything, I guess I just overthought how to attack and went in circles...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's surely still fighting right now. In that case,
I'll prepare something that can serve as a weapon...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—a quiet night fell.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...You took your time.
I thought you'd get here a bit sooner."
choice_data_list: How was the catch?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still zero, as usual.
Not even a single snag on the bottom~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentle waves lapped against the shore, washing away the silence.
As we cast our lines side by side in silence, Seiun Sky slowly began to speak—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Of course I wasn't being serious.
Saying that I was tired of racing, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking.
About what it takes to overcome walls and break through limits.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Facing a rival who grows stronger without limit,
how can I, who am about to hit my ceiling, ever win...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I just felt like... if I dropped a fishing line like this,
a great strategy would come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So... saying you're tired of it
just means you're not taking it seriously.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I know.
Yeah, I know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha.
Nothing gets past you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...King probably understood a bit too.
Even so, I bet it still felt frustrating for her."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm—
really in trouble here."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, but in the end it was a bust.
I couldn't think of a single thing. Drew a total blank!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I give up, I surrender, white flag!
...Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A girl like me...
is boring, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Boring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words she spoke back then.
They were directed at no one else—
but herself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, everyone reaches the end of the line eventually.
So you might as well just throw in the towel and be done with it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, it's already a miracle
that someone as frail as me has achieved this much.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I ran in the Classics,
and Grandpa was happy about it too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You did great, good job!
I should honestly give myself a pat on the back too!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you did great.
Yeah, you worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Right? Isn't that so?
Sei-chan has already achieved plenty of results!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're the best Umamusume there is.
Yeah, you're the best Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know...
I just can't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —That very moment when everyone's opinions changed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Surprise! A buzz! Cheers! Screams!
That single moment when everything was turned upside down...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I want to taste it one more time.
I want to feel that excitement...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I can't catch anything 'here' anymore, can I?
Yet I still cast my line, unable to forget.
choice_data_list: Seiun Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "'Don't you want to win anymore?' ...she asked."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course I want to win.
That's why I've kept running all this time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I just...
don't know anymore.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"This is as far as you can go!"
...I can see a wall with those words written on it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Until now, I've managed to get by by finding holes to crawl through or climbing right over.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But this time, there's a definite dead end.
Running toward that... is terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm scared.
Scared of being forced to realize that it's impossible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Seiun Sky looked down while saying that,
I could see a glittering droplet in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how carefree or composed she seemed,
she must have constantly been fighting against anxiety.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, Trainer.
You don't have to apologize for that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because no one else
can do anything about this...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, the only one you can truly rely on...
is yourself, you know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had said something similar in the past.
True, in the end, you have to overcome it with your own power.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Aagh! Dammit.
The fish aren't even biting either...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Seriously!
I look so uncool right now.
choice_data_list: I did everything I could for you, didn't I?
You did everything you could, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
No matter how much you shake it now, nothing's gonna come out.
choice_data_list: Then it's my turn next!
Then it's my turn next!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean by—wait, why are you
heading towards the ocean... H-Hold on—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splaash!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!?
Trainer, are you okay!?
choice_data_list: I'll corner the fish! Be ready with the landing net!
I'll corner the fish! Be ready with the landing net!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, what?
Y-You figured it out...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after driving the fish toward
Seiun Sky on the beach, the result was—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Small fish, acquired.
choice_data_list: Even a small fish is a fine catch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I mean... is this our "catch"?
We weren't... really fishing, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait. Um...
Sorry, but I'm really confused right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What... was that just now?
choice_data_list: Even if it's scary, if you muster up your courage, something will change!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You went all the way to the sea just to tell me that?
Ahhh~ I see~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh... Ahaha...!
What is that even supposed to mean?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's so unlike you, Trainer...!
Whew, you really startled me...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... Putting yourself on the line like that
just to cheer me up. You're too much.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even if we do that...
it doesn't change the fact that the wall is still there.
choice_data_list: Still, we haven't tried breaking it yet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: I want you to be brave and take it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...And if all you get out of it is getting hurt,
what will you do then?"
choice_data_list: As you are now, you can definitely break through it.
As you are now, you can definitely break it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with those words, I handed Seiun Sky
the materials I had prepared since morning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Is this... my training log up until now?
It even summarizes race strategies up to the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you even wrote down the parts where I slacked off.
...I really am quite a troublesome Umamusume, aren't I?
choice_data_list: You'll surprise me even more in the race, right?
You'll surprise me even more in the race, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll show up for training.
But as for the race, I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I might get scared and run away.
...Are you okay with that?
choice_data_list: I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I'll be back before curfew,
so please, just leave me alone a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky will definitely show up at the race having figured something out.
Believing that, I left the area—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch.
Believe in me, huh?"
